title: Emergence and interstate spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in dairy cattle in the United States | Science
content: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) viruses cross species barriers and have the potential to cause pandemics. In North America, HPAI A(H5N1) viruses related to the goose/Guangdong 2.3.4.4b hemagglutinin phylogenetic clade have infected wild birds, ...
